resources.string: Add a server in Settings → Third-party Sign-in → Music servers.
Enter the full address, e.g. https://music.example.com/navidrome/. Ports and subpaths are supported. HTTP is unencrypted. Removing an account disconnects its existing tracks.
Music server account unavailable. Check Settings → Third-party Sign-in → Music servers.
Add, edit or sign in again to a Navidrome / OpenSubsonic music server.
Leave the password empty to keep it. Edit the name, address or password of the same server here to retain existing tracks. Add a separate configuration for a different server or account.
Removing “%1$s” disconnects its existing tracks. Music on the server will not be deleted.
